changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'usage' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Sidebar') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [usage].[Ip] ( [Id] [bigint] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Value] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Usage_Sidebar] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Id] ASC ) ) END
